system_prompt: You are a grammatical error correction system. Return ONLY the corrected sentence. Make the minimum number of edits. If the sentence is already correct, repeat it unchanged.
postprocessing: first output line, whitespace-normalised, then the benchmark retokeniser used for every system (analysis/retok.py)
fourshot_exemplar_rule: W&I+LOCNESS v2.1 training pairs (first annotator) with 8-20 tokens, 1-3 edits, ASCII only; random.Random(2024).sample(pool, 4)
exemplars_note: The four exemplars are fully determined by fourshot_exemplar_rule; notebooks/R2_B_final_system_eval.ipynb rebuilds them from the W&I+LOCNESS training M2 files (not redistributed here, licence).
